name: Film frame
subjects: two people across a diner table
a driver, only the eyes in the rear-view
hotel clerk under a brass lamp
dancer after the number, still in costume
actions: sliding an envelope across the table
not saying the thing both of them know
pouring a drink they will not finish
checking a watch that has stopped
settings: motel room, ugly lamp, open suitcase
camera: wide, subject small in the frame
twists: the clock on the wall does not match the one on the nightstand
there is a third coffee cup and only two people
the gun on the table has never been mentioned
the window looks onto a different city than the door
credits would roll if anyone moved
